title: InitiatorKind
description:
The kind of initiator, without the associated identifier payload.

Used in permission rules and policy resolution where only the category of initiator matters, not the specific identity.

oneOf.description: A human user initiated the run interactively.
A scheduled or recurring task initiated the run.
An external messaging channel triggered the run.
A parent agent run spawned this as a sub-agent.
A schedule (cron / interval / one-shot / webhook) started the run. Behaves like [`InitiatorKind::Human`] unless a rule says otherwise, but never auto-approves money or never-list actions.
